The '''Overdrive Crate''' is a special time-limited crate. It also contains only crate-exclusive units; that is, none of these units will appear in regular supply drops.

Cost: 60 Volt Coins per open

Contents:
* [[Defiance]] x1 (unique to this crate)
* [[Vulture]] x2 (unique to this crate)
* [[Nostromos]] x2 (unique to this crate)
* [[Inquisitor]] x4 (unique to this crate)
* [[Mercator]] x4 (unique to this crate)
* [[Nighthawk]] x4 (unique to this crate)
* [[Char Infantry]] x8 (unique to this crate)
* [[Duneshredder]] x8 (this crate or [[Ignition Crate]] only)
* [[Torbuck]] x8 (unique to this crate)
* [[Mantis]] x8 (this crate or [[Ignition Crate]] only)
